library ieee;
use ieee.std_logic_1164.all;

entity counter is
  generic (
    WIDTH : positive := 8
  );
  port (
    clk    : in  std_logic;
    rst_n  : in  std_logic;
    enable : in  std_logic;
    count  : out std_logic_vector(WIDTH-1 downto 0)
  );
end entity counter;

architecture rtl of counter is
begin
end architecture rtl;
